value.basis: Lab 4-choice spatially compatible RT in young adults averages ~400-450 ms (Hick's law, Deary et al. young cohorts); browser/keyboard/display latency adds ~40-70 ms, and only 5 practice trials leaves some early learning in the scored block, nudging the median up slightly. Between-person SD of individual medians in healthy young adults is typically 50-70 ms, inflated somewhat by heterogeneous home hardware.
